- The final successful output was generated by this exact rule and includes original marker unchanged.

Demos varied marker/background colors and marker shape, consistent with the same general rule: copy the provided non-background marker pattern into every matching background-color placement. For future instances, derive stencil from marker, identify background and marker color, test direct translations against the original grid. The task can be noisy and accidental matches are still valid; avoid overthinking rotations unless a demo establishes them.
